analysis.overall: You spent a good portion of the day in a solid target range, though you dealt with a late-night climb and an early morning drift downward.

events.title: Evening Meal
events.description: A 20g carb bolus handled smoothly for a while, though it required a few minor corrections later in the evening as numbers crept up.

events.title: Late Night Climb
events.description: Glucose drifted up toward 190 mg/dL, requiring a sequence of small correction boluses and automated adjustments to bring it back down.

events.title: Early Morning Low
events.description: After the overnight corrections wore off, glucose drifted down to a minimum of 58 mg/dL before recovering nicely.

events.title: Breakfast and Spike
events.description: A 50g carb breakfast led to a sharp upward trend, peaking around 208 mg/dL before insulin brought things back down toward noon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on the post-breakfast rise; pre-bolusing slightly earlier might help blunt that morning spike.
